name: Shiino Kirari
source:
Kirari is the vocalist of the band.
She meets [url=/c343]Shikanosuke[/url] when she begins working at the restaurant where he works. Her family is very poor, so she works mornings and evenings to make ends meet. However, her cheerful, spontaneous attitude normally masks this hardship. Her disheveled hair and her bright smile are her trademark features.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/2609C708-8684-42E1-92F0-17ED568F3CED/kirakira]Mangagamer[/url]]
